Interconnect and chip-edge features. Choose one by the stacking or packaging feature you need.

## `indium_bump`

One centered square indium bump, with an optional under-bump contact pad.

![Default layout of `indium_bump`.](../../_static/images/components/indium_bump.svg)

Details: [Component guide](../../public-pdk-examples/components/indium_bump.qmd)

## `indium_ground`

A centered regular field of passive indium bumps that can skip sites overlapping a keepout region.

![Default layout of `indium_ground`.](../../_static/images/components/indium_ground.png)

Details: [Component guide](../../public-pdk-examples/components/indium_ground.qmd)

## `dicing_edge`

A rectangular edge ring on a chosen layer, drawn as an outer rectangle minus an inner one. It is meant for an ETCH or marker layer at the chip edge.

![Default layout of `dicing_edge`.](../../_static/images/components/dicing_edge.svg)

Details: [Function reference](../../reference/cells.dicing_edge.qmd)
